title: Zoning text change for 63-02 Fresh Pond Road, Queens
summary: This resolution approves a zoning text amendment establishing a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area for a site at 63-02 Fresh Pond Road in Ridgewood, Queens. It works alongside a related zoning map change to allow a new seven-story mixed-use building with 54 apartments, including 13 income-restricted units. The City Council approved the City Planning Commission's decision with modifications on July 14, 2026.
